# platform-orchestrator_role (Resource)

A configurable organization role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_permissions" "available" {}

resource "platform-orchestrator_role" "module_maintainer" {
  display_name = "Module Maintainer"
  permissions = [
    "module_read",
    "module_write",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The role's display name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The complete set of granular permission identifiers assigned to the role.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the role was created.
- `created_by` (String) The UUID of the user that created the role.
- `id` (String) The role UUID.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether this is an immutable built-in role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_role.module_maintainer 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
